storage: Stock-owned immutable private MySQL LONGBLOB, <=20MiB, signature allowlist PNG/JPEG/PDF, attachment/nosniff/no-store; not ticket files, not public URL
authority: Current identity.stock.read/manage plus explicit warehouseIds; writes also require current CSRF and Origin; tenant/actor never accepted from JSON
idempotency: Same UUID identical full command replays immutable original result; changed parameters409; no second balance increment; same-key concurrent actor/warehouse checked before replay
transaction: warehouse -> part -> balance order; receipt normal immutable SELECT; balance+operation+movement+audit+outbox one transaction; uncertain rollback/commit connection quarantined/aborted, no restoreAutoCommit

routes.unknown: GET original fileId; 404 requires explicit same UUID same bytes; never automatic retry or generate new UUID

routes.result: Current warehouse read authorization, attachment, no-store, single explicit bytes=start-end or start- Range; suffix/multiple invalid =>416
Original actor only, current warehouse and evidence read permission; no write; 404 unknown or inaccessible
Existing current stock.read+warehouse scope; onHand/reserved/available/rowVersion strings

limits: No frontend inbound page in this slice
Outbox is a committed owner fact only, no stock delivery worker or notification claimed
No retention cleanup/delete endpoint yet: evidence retained, never falsely marked cleaned; cleanup and accounting reference protection required before enabling deletion
Signature allowlist only; no antivirus or full document validation claim
